verdict.rationale: Missive documents assigning conversations to a team or a specific person while keeping visibility (docs-6), and rules and automations (up to 1000 rules) that can run in timed steps. Its example rule escalates to the lead and reassigns unanswered support emails, showing rules can change ownership automatically (docs-57/58/59). Shared accounts can be scoped to teams (docs-74). missing for 10: detailed docs on rule conditions and actions for routing incoming mail on arrival (e.g., by sender or keyword to a team), and independent or hands-on corroboration of assignment and rule routing.
